selected.rationale: The advertiser provides general wellness services, and the Wellness Optimizer has a direct affinity for wellness and fitness with a low price sensitivity matching the mid-tier estimated AOV of 50 USD, making them an ideal fit to reach on Studiogrid and Daily Form.
The Fitness Enthusiast actively engages in fitness services and recovery, aligning directly with the wellness services category of the advertiser and reachable via Studiogrid.
The Convenience-First Millennial values speed and frictionlessness in booking and services, matching the appointment-based and user-friendly nature of Studiogrid and Daily Form.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent focuses heavily on family and kids products, which does not align with the individual-focused wellness services offered by the advertiser.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses primarily on beauty and fashion trends through TikTok and Instagram, rather than the core wellness services category of the advertiser.
The Pet Parent focuses strictly on pet food and pet health, completely misaligned with human wellness services.
The Affluent Classic prefers high-AOV traditional items like classic apparel and home goods, whereas the advertiser operates in a mid-tier general wellness service model.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses on physical eco-friendly goods and supply chains rather than intangible wellness services.
The Value-Conscious Shopper seeks heavy discounts and household bundles, which does not fit the mid-tier wellness service positioning.
The Gifter shops for physical gifts and explicitly dislikes self-care-only framing and subscriptions, making them unsuitable for an advertiser helping people feel better through wellness services.
